{{Top|leg}}
The '''biorestorative underlay''' was an [[Armor/Legends|armor]] enhancement that hastened the healing processes of the wearer during combat. The Mark I, II, III, IV, and V versions in turn allowed for a considerable increase in the speed in which the body healed itself. Furthermore, the Mark IV and V versions boosted the body's resiliency to damage.

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords|''Knights of the Old Republic II'']], this upgrade can be used on all types of armor and robes.
